scope: read actual built projector image before starting bounded refresh

predecessor.relation: corrective follow-up for post-build image lookup seam

hosted_dev_incident.failure_summary: post-build projector_img_id lookup queried 'docker compose images -q source-ingest-agora-projector', which queries created containers rather than the just-built image. Because no steady projector container exists and bounded containers were removed prior to build, the query exited 0 with empty output, causing false stale_projector_image rejection despite successful build.

changes: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh: changed post-build projector_img_id lookup to inspect 'pantheon-source-ingest-agora-projector:latest' directly via docker inspect --format '{{.Id}}', resolving the built image independent of absent or old containers, preserving exact OCI revision check and fail-closed guards with 0 net line growth

scripts/test_dev_tw_market_refresh.py: updated docker stub to reflect absent projector container and handle built projector image inspection; added 3 shell-boundary regression tests verifying absent container acceptance, preference of newly built valid image over old container image, and fail-closed termination on missing built image
